name: closeCashDesk
intent: Close the selected cash desk and make it the current cash desk.
pre: A cash desk with the supplied cashDeskID exists.
The selected cash desk is open.
post: Make the selected cash desk the current cash desk.
Mark the selected cash desk as closed.
difficulty_basis: Guarded desk-state change and current-desk binding without branching.
scenarios: Opened desk/store become closed desk and current binding; true result checked.
Missing desk and current store violate explicit guards.
effects_audit: No requirement that selected desk belongs to current store is invented; current-desk binding retained.
